ESV.1: This is the book of the generations of Adam. When God created man, he made him in the likeness of God.
ESV.2: Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and named them Man  when they were created.
ESV.3: When Adam had lived 130 years, he fathered a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
ESV.4: The days of Adam after he fathered Seth were 800 years; and he had other sons and daughters.
ESV.5: Thus all the days that Adam lived were 930 years, and he died.
ESV.6: When Seth had lived 105 years, he fathered Enosh.
ESV.7: Seth lived after he fathered Enosh 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
ESV.8: Thus all the days of Seth were 912 years, and he died.
ESV.9: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he fathered Kenan.
ESV.10: Enosh lived after he fathered Kenan 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
ESV.11: Thus all the days of Enosh were 905 years, and he died.
ESV.12: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he fathered Mahalalel.
ESV.13: Kenan lived after he fathered Mahalalel 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
ESV.14: Thus all the days of Kenan were 910 years, and he died.
ESV.15: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he fathered Jared.
ESV.16: Mahalalel lived after he fathered Jared 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
ESV.17: Thus all the days of Mahalalel were 895 years, and he died.
ESV.18: When Jared had lived 162 years, he fathered Enoch.
ESV.19: Jared lived after he fathered Enoch 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
ESV.20: Thus all the days of Jared were 962 years, and he died.
ESV.21: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he fathered Methuselah.
ESV.22: Enoch walked with God  after he fathered Methuselah 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
ESV.23: Thus all the days of Enoch were 365 years.
ESV.24: Enoch walked with God, and he was not,  for God took him.
ESV.25: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he fathered Lamech.
ESV.26: Methuselah lived after he fathered Lamech 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
ESV.27: Thus all the days of Methuselah were 969 years, and he died.
ESV.28: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he fathered a son
ESV.29: and called his name Noah, saying, “Out of the ground that the LORD has cursed, this one shall bring us relief  from our work and from the painful toil of our hands.”
ESV.30: Lamech lived after he fathered Noah 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
ESV.31: Thus all the days of Lamech were 777 years, and he died.
ESV.32: After Noah was 500 years old, Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

NKJV.1: This is the book of the genealogy of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in the likeness of God.
NKJV.2: He created them male and female, and blessed them and called them Mankind in the day they were created.
NKJV.3: And Adam lived one hundred and thirty years, and begot a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
NKJV.4: After he begot Seth, the days of Adam were eight hundred years; and he had sons and daughters.
NKJV.5: So all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.
NKJV.6: Seth lived one hundred and five years, and begot Enosh.
NKJV.7: After he begot Enosh, Seth lived eight hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters.
NKJV.8: So all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.
NKJV.9: Enosh lived ninety years, and begot Cainan.
NKJV.10: After he begot Cainan, Enosh lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and had sons and daughters.
NKJV.11: So all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years; and he died.
NKJV.12: Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalalel.
NKJV.13: After he begot Mahalalel, Cainan lived eight hundred and forty years, and had sons and daughters.
NKJV.14: So all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.
NKJV.15: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and begot Jared.
NKJV.16: After he begot Jared, Mahalalel lived eight hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters.
NKJV.17: So all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred and ninety-five years; and he died.
NKJV.18: Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years, and begot Enoch.
NKJV.19: After he begot Enoch, Jared lived eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters.
NKJV.20: So all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years; and he died.
NKJV.21: Enoch lived sixty-five years, and begot Methuselah.
NKJV.22: After he begot Methuselah, Enoch walked with God three hundred years, and had sons and daughters.
NKJV.23: So all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.
NKJV.24: And Enoch walked with God; and he was not, for God took him.
NKJV.25: Methuselah lived one hundred and eighty-seven years, and begot Lamech.
NKJV.26: After he begot Lamech, Methuselah lived seven hundred and eighty-two years, and had sons and daughters.
NKJV.27: So all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred and sixty-nine years; and he died.
NKJV.28: Lamech lived one hundred and eighty-two years, and had a son.
NKJV.29: And he called his name Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us concerning our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD has cursed.”
NKJV.30: After he begot Noah, Lamech lived five hundred and ninety-five years, and had sons and daughters.
NKJV.31: So all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years; and he died.
NKJV.32: And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

WEB.1: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
WEB.2: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them “Adam”.
WEB.3: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
WEB.4: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
WEB.5: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
WEB.6: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
WEB.7: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
WEB.8: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
WEB.9: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
WEB.10: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan, eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
WEB.11: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
WEB.12: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
WEB.13: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
WEB.14: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
WEB.15: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
WEB.16: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
WEB.17: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
WEB.18: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
WEB.19: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
WEB.20: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
WEB.21: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
WEB.22: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
WEB.23: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
WEB.24: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
WEB.25: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
WEB.26: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
WEB.27: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
WEB.28: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
WEB.29: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”
WEB.30: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
WEB.31: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
WEB.32: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

AMP.1: This is the book (the written record, the history) of the generations of [the descendants of] Adam. When God created man, He made him in the likeness of God [not physical, but a spiritual personality and moral likeness].
AMP.2: He created them male and female, and blessed them and named them Mankind at the time they were created.
AMP.3: When Adam had lived a hundred and thirty years, he became the father of a son in his own likeness, according to his image, and named him Seth.
AMP.4: After he became the father of Seth, Adam lived eight hundred years and had other sons and daughters.
AMP.5: So Adam lived nine hundred and thirty years in all, and he died.
AMP.6: When Seth was a hundred and five years old, he became the father of Enosh.
AMP.7: Seth lived eight hundred and seven years after the birth of Enosh, and he had other sons and daughters.
AMP.8: So Seth lived nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.
AMP.9: When Enosh was ninety years old, he became the father of Kenan.
AMP.10: Enosh lived eight hundred and fifteen years after the birth of Kenan and had other sons and daughters.
AMP.11: So Enosh lived nine hundred and five years, and he died.
AMP.12: When Kenan was seventy years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
AMP.13: Kenan lived eight hundred and forty years after the birth of Mahalalel and had other sons and daughters.
AMP.14: So Kenan lived nine hundred and ten years, and he died.
AMP.15: When Mahalalel was sixty-five years old, he became the father of Jared.
AMP.16: Mahalalel lived eight hundred and thirty years after the birth of Jared and had other sons and daughters.
AMP.17: So Mahalalel lived eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.
AMP.18: When Jared was a hundred and sixty-two years old, he became the father of Enoch.
AMP.19: Jared lived eight hundred years after the birth of Enoch and had other sons and daughters.
AMP.20: So Jared lived nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.
AMP.21: When Enoch was sixty-five years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
AMP.22: Enoch walked [in habitual fellowship] with God three hundred years after the birth of Methuselah and had other sons and daughters.
AMP.23: So all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.
AMP.24: And [in reverent fear and obedience] Enoch walked with God; and he was not [found among men], because God took him [away to be home with Him].
AMP.25: When Methuselah was a hundred and eighty-seven years old, he became the father of Lamech.
AMP.26: Methuselah lived seven hundred and eighty-two years after the birth of Lamech and had other sons and daughters.
AMP.27: So Methuselah lived nine hundred and sixty-nine years, and he died.
AMP.28: When Lamech was a hundred and eighty-two years old, he became the father of a son.
AMP.29: He named him Noah, saying, "This one shall bring us rest and comfort from our work and from the [dreadful] toil of our hands because of the ground which the LORD cursed."
AMP.30: Lamech lived five hundred and ninety-five years after the birth of Noah and had other sons and daughters.
AMP.31: So all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years, and he died.
AMP.32: After Noah was five hundred years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

NLT.1: This is the written account of the descendants of Adam. When God created human beings, he made them to be like himself.
NLT.2: He created them male and female, and he blessed them and called them “human.”
NLT.3: When Adam was 130 years old, he became the father of a son who was just like him — in his very image. He named his son Seth.
NLT.4: After the birth of Seth, Adam lived another 800 years, and he had other sons and daughters.

NIV.1:
From Adam to Noah
This is the written account of Adam’s line.
When God created man, he made him in the likeness of God.
NIV.2: He created them male and female and blessed them. And when they were created, he called them “man.”
NIV.3: When Adam had lived 130 years, he had a son in his own likeness, in his own image; and he named him Seth.
NIV.4: After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.5: Altogether, Adam lived 930 years, and then he died.
NIV.6: When Seth had lived 105 years, he became the father of Enosh.
NIV.7: And after he became the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.8: Altogether, Seth lived 912 years, and then he died.
NIV.9: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan.
NIV.10: And after he became the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.11: Altogether, Enosh lived 905 years, and then he died.
NIV.12: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel.
NIV.13: And after he became the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.14: Altogether, Kenan lived 910 years, and then he died.
NIV.15: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared.
NIV.16: And after he became the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.17: Altogether, Mahalalel lived 895 years, and then he died.
NIV.18: When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch.
NIV.19: And after he became the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.20: Altogether, Jared lived 962 years, and then he died.
NIV.21: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he became the father of Methuselah.
NIV.22: And after he became the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.24: Enoch walked with God; then he was no more, because God took him away.
NIV.25: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he became the father of Lamech.
NIV.26: And after he became the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.27: Altogether, Methuselah lived 969 years, and then he died.
NIV.28: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he had a son.
NIV.29: He named him Noah and said, “He will comfort us in the labor and painful toil of our hands caused by the ground the Lord has cursed.”
NIV.30: After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
NIV.31: Altogether, Lamech lived 777 years, and then he died.
NIV.32: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.
